content:
nina: Heads-up: ~25 1-GPU pods pending in ap-southeast1, looks like AZ B is saturated and scheduler is avoiding cross-AZ placement.
raj: Can you paste a short `kubectl get pods` and node labels?
nina: snippet:
```
job-a    Pending  InsufficientGPU
job-b    Pending  InsufficientGPU
```
nodes:
```
node-a  zone=ap-southeast1a  gpu=4  taints=gpu-enterprise:NoSchedule
node-b  zone=ap-southeast1b  gpu=8  taints=
node-c  zone=ap-southeast1c  gpu=0  taints=gpu-realtime:NoSchedule
```
carmen: Looks like `preferSameZone` is causing stickiness. Proposal: canary relax zone affinity for pods with `tiny-gpu=true` and `resources.requests.gpu<=1` in ap-southeast1 only.
raj: Also run a scoped defrag that only migrates non-stateful tiny pods and respects taints/labels.
sysbot: scheduled: /ops/scheduler-canary/6555550000 for 2026-03-21T16:10Z. Alert thresholds: pending_gpus>20, p95_schedule_time>120s.
nina: Add cost guardrail: if autoscaler adds >2 nodes, post to #finance-alerts and pause autoscaler.
carmen: I'll open the PR and include monitoring + rollback plan. Will paste policy JSON here when ready.
